conflict_definition.transition_overlap: same original transition belongs to at least two selected windows
conflict_definition.target_label_conflict: overlapping window proposals assign more than one distinct KMeans target label to the same original transition
conflict_definition.exact_independent_targets_jointly_compat: no target-label conflict occurs on any transition required by those independent proposals

rules: No poisoned HDF5 dataset is generated.
No overlap conflict-resolution rule is introduced.
No CQL, DT, BC, or MTM learner is trained.
S2 is used only because it exactly represents the already-frozen type-complete diagnostic interpretation.
The existing canonical perturb_selected_window function is reused unchanged.
Each selected window is optimized independently before conflicts are measured.
The rho=0.01 selected-window list must be an exact prefix of rho=0.05 within each seed.
No first-wins, last-wins, averaging, voting, or overwrite rule is tested in this diagnostic.
No conflict-resolution strategy may be selected before these results are recorded.
